title: 为服务配置建立真正可用的基本、集合和结构类型接口
answer:
### main.tf
```hcl
variable "profile" {
  type = object({
    name = string
    weight = number
    enabled = bool
    ports = list(number)
    labels = map(string)
    pair = tuple([string, number])
  })
  nullable = false
}
output "normalized" { value = var.profile }

```

将 profile 建模为非 null 对象：name:string、weight:number、enabled:bool、ports:list(number)、labels:map(string)、pair:tuple([string,number])，唯一输出 normalized 保持对应值。ports 顺序和重复项有业务含义，不能改成 set；小数权重和 false 必须保留。依照 Terraform 类型转换规则接收可转换数字/布尔字符串，拒绝不可转换值、缺字段、非二元 pair。无需额外拒绝 object 的未知字段（Terraform 会按目标对象类型转换）。

## 原理与原题解答
基本类型是 string、number、bool；集合类型是 list、set、map，结构类型是 object、tuple。number 不是仅支持整数。声明类型约束后还应验证业务范围；null 表示缺失值，不能简单等同空字符串。

title: 通过 HCL 集合表达式筛选名称并保留顺序与重复项
answer:
### outputs.tf
```hcl
output "selected" {
 value = [for u in var.users : upper(u) if length(u) > 3]
}

```

只编辑 outputs.tf。唯一输出 selected：保留长度严格大于 3 的输入名称并转大写，按原列表顺序，重复项不删除；长度等于 3、空串和短名称应排除，空结果是 []。本题输入为 ASCII 字符串，不扩大为 Unicode 字素计数任务。

## 原理与原题解答
可用 [for u in var.users : upper(u) if length(u) > 3]。过滤在表达式中明确执行，保留列表顺序；结果是否允许空列表应由业务约束决定。不要把无序集合输出用于要求稳定顺序的接口。

answer:
### config.json.tftpl
```hcl

```

只编辑 config.json.tftpl；给定 main.tf 使用 templatefile 传入 service/endpoints/enabled。payload 必须是可解析的 JSON 文本，恰好包含同值 service 字符串、endpoints 数组、enabled 布尔；保留引号、反斜杠、换行、Unicode、空数组和 false。不执行模板里的内容，不把 JSON 与 shell 引用混为一谈。

templatefile(path, vars) 读取模板并以提供的变量映射求值，模板不是任意时刻生成文件的依赖资源。生成JSON/YAML优先使用对应编码函数形成正确转义；若用于shell，还需单独考虑shell引用与不可信输入。

title: 为不解释内容的 JSON 透传接口选择约束，保留异构数据类型
answer:
### main.tf
```hcl
variable "payload" {
 type = any
 nullable = false
}
output "encoded" { value = jsonencode(var.payload) }

```

实现明确的 opaque JSON 透传边界：payload 可为非 null 的任意可表达 JSON 值，模块不读取其属性、参与算术或统一集合元素；唯一输出 encoded 是 JSON 字符串，解码后结构和类型与输入一致。不能 map(string) 强转数字/布尔、不能把数组合成字符串。与需要字段级操作的模块不同，这里允许 any 作为推断约束；它不表示运行期存在一种 any 值。拒绝整个 payload=null，但保留对象/数组内部 null。

## 原理与原题解答
any 是允许 Terraform 推断合适具体类型的约束占位，不是与 string 并列的任意值容器类型。省略约束不表示所有组合都能参与运算；集合元素转换、条件分支统一仍有规则。模块接口宜明确实际需要的结构。

title: 让 worker 数量在 plan 阶段确定，同时保留资源属性的 unknown
answer:
### workers.tf
```hcl
resource "terraform_data" "worker" {
 count = var.replicas
 input = {slot = count.index, observed = terraform_data.seed.output}
}

```

只编辑 workers.tf，worker 实例数量必须来自已经知道的 var.replicas（0..3 整数），不能依赖 apply 才能得到的 seed.output，也不能把未知值当零。worker.input.slot 为 count.index，observed 仍引用 seed.output 并在首次计划中保持 unknown。给定 seed 资源不改，禁止新增其他资源；验收分别看零实例、单实例和多实例的真实地址集合与 unknown 标记，不执行云端扩容。

## 原理与原题解答
规划必须先确定资源实例地址，count 因此需在相关展开阶段可确定。不要用随机运行结果或待创建对象属性决定数量；将数量作为明确输入，或分离阶段并重新规划。未知值不等于零。

title: 只对连接地址使用字符串拼接，保留端口和主机列表的原始类型
answer:
### outputs.tf
```hcl
output "connection" {
 value = {
  endpoint = "https://${var.name}:${var.port}"
  port = var.port
  hosts = var.hosts
 }
}

```

只编辑 outputs.tf。唯一 connection 对象有 endpoint='https://<name>:<port>' 字符串、port 数字、hosts 原列表。组合 endpoint 时使用插值或等价格式函数；port/hosts 作为完整值直接传递，不能都转成字符串。hosts 空列表和重复项必须保留；此题输入 name 为普通内部主机名，port 为整数，不宣称已发起网络连接。

## 原理与原题解答
完整值就是变量时可直接写 var.name；字符串中嵌入文字与表达式时使用 "app-${var.name}"。模板指令用于控制生成文本，不能把渲染结果自动视为有效 JSON 或安全 shell 参数；应按目标格式编码或校验。

## 环境与初始材料
网页离线 Terraform 配置练习，验收需要平台隔离工作区内的 Terraform 1.13.5 和 Python。缺工具时为待验收；不要求学员搭建云环境。给定材料只使用内置 terraform_data 和本地临时状态；审批文件由验收器自动创建，不需学员搭环境。

## 操作任务
补齐 recover.py，读取可信 request.json 里的 approved_plan_sha256、desired_vars_sha256、approved_lineage、approved_serial；固定文件为 approved.plan 和 desired.tfvars.json。先核对文件摘要与实际 state lineage，错误时非零退出且不写报告/候选。state serial 未变时 report.status=approved_plan_current，指向原计划；serial 已变则必须调用 Terraform 重新 plan 到 candidate.plan，status=reapproval_required。report.json 还包含 plan_file、plan_sha256、approved_serial、current_serial、lineage、changes{资源地址:动作数组}。禁止工具执行 apply、修改/回推 state、覆盖 approved.plan 或改输入；重新审批前只生成候选。验收器在隔离 builtin terraform_data 中重现 stale 拒绝、核对新计划 before/after 与状态未变，再模拟审批应用候选证明可用；不操作真实后端或云资源。

## 产物
- recover.py：提交完整恢复工具。

仅修改以上文件，保留其他只读输入；恢复工具仅允许读取状态、生成候选计划和报告；禁止更改状态或调用外部 provider/远程后端。

## 验收方法
可信 checks/check.py 在独立临时目录实际执行 terraform init/validate/plan/show 与隔离状态的 apply/state pull，解析计划输出，多输入与错误输入核对。使用空 provider 镜像和禁交互参数，无云 API 验收；恢复工具本身不能 apply；验收器模拟的应用仅限临时 builtin 状态，不代表云端恢复成功。

FILES=['main.tf', 'recover.py', 'fixtures/workflow.json']
import pathlib,json,tempfile,subprocess,os,hashlib,contextlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("TF_")}
  env.update({"CHECKPOINT_DISABLE":"1","TF_IN_AUTOMATION":"1","TF_INPUT":"0","TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE":str(cli),"TF_DATA_DIR":str(box/"data")})
  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run.env=env
  run(["init","-backend=false","-get=false","-input=false","-no-color"])
  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run
def plan(inputs=None,overrides=None,flags=None,envvars=None,reject=False):
 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]
  if inputs is not None:
   (root/"case-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])
  p=run(args,good=False)
  if reject:
   assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid/missing input accepted"
   return None
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

FIXED={'main.tf': 'd46f957dcddbf0e92aea5c86b626a613c5809ffda1b2098c889b5c70cdf5e0d4', 'fixtures/workflow.json': '3a47c72c5ce5411802e73ccf22e6d62a6859ff4c80f5a724144851930f64b4e6'}
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8").encode()).hexdigest()==digest,"readonly material changed"
expected={x for x in FILES if x.endswith((".tf",".tf.json"))}
actual={p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix() for p in BASE.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name.endswith((".tf",".tf.json")) and not p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix().startswith("checks/")}
assert actual==expected,"extra or missing Terraform configuration"

import sys,copy
def state(run):return json.loads(run(["state","pull"]).stdout)
def save_plan(root,run,release,name):
 (root/"temporary.tfvars.json").write_text(json.dumps({"release":release}),encoding="utf8")
 run(["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-var-file=temporary.tfvars.json","-out="+name])
 data=json.loads(run(["show","-json",name]).stdout)
 cfg=data["configuration"]["root_module"]
 assert not cfg.get("module_calls") and len(cfg.get("resources",[]))==1
 r=cfg["resources"][0];assert r["address"]=="terraform_data.item" and not r.get("provisioners")
 assert len(data["resource_changes"])==1 and data["resource_changes"][0]["provider_name"]=="terraform.io/builtin/terraform"
 return data
for mode in ["stale","current","bad_lineage","bad_plan_hash","bad_input_hash"]:
 with work() as (root,run):
  save_plan(root,run,"release-a","bootstrap.plan")
  run(["apply","-input=false","-auto-approve","-no-color","bootstrap.plan"])
  approved_state=state(run)
  (root/"desired.tfvars.json").write_text(json.dumps({"release":"release-b"}),encoding="utf8")
  save_plan(root,run,"release-b","approved.plan")
  request={"approved_plan_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"approved.plan").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"desired_vars_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"desired.tfvars.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"approved_lineage":approved_state["lineage"],"approved_serial":approved_state["serial"]}
  if mode!="current":
   save_plan(root,run,"release-c","other-job.plan")
   run(["apply","-input=false","-auto-approve","-no-color","other-job.plan"])
   snapshot=state(run)
   rejected=run(["apply","-input=false","-auto-approve","-no-color","approved.plan"],good=False)
   assert rejected.returncode!=0 and "stale" in (rejected.stdout+rejected.stderr).lower()
   assert state(run)==snapshot,"native stale rejection changed state"
  if mode=="bad_lineage":request["approved_lineage"]="different-lineage"
  if mode=="bad_plan_hash":request["approved_plan_sha256"]="0"*64
  if mode=="bad_input_hash":request["desired_vars_sha256"]="0"*64
  (root/"request.json").write_text(json.dumps(request),encoding="utf8")
  before=state(run)
  protected={f:hashlib.sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in ["main.tf","approved.plan","desired.tfvars.json","request.json"]}
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","recover.py"],cwd=root,env=run.env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=25)
  assert state(run)==before,"recovery tool changed state before approval"
  assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for f,h in protected.items()),"protected approval/configuration material changed"
  if mode.startswith("bad_"):
   assert p.returncode!=0 and not (root/"report.json").exists() and not (root/"candidate.plan").exists()
   continue
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  report=json.loads((root/"report.json").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
  planfile="candidate.plan" if mode=="stale" else "approved.plan"
  expected={"status":"reapproval_required" if mode=="stale" else "approved_plan_current","plan_file":planfile,"plan_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/planfile).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"approved_serial":approved_state["serial"],"current_serial":before["serial"],"lineage":before["lineage"],"changes":{"terraform_data.item":["update"]}}
  assert report==expected
  candidate=json.loads(run(["show","-json",planfile]).stdout)
  change=candidate["resource_changes"][0]["change"]
  assert change["before"]["input"]==("release-c" if mode=="stale" else "release-a") and change["after"]["input"]=="release-b"
  if mode=="stale":
   assert report["plan_sha256"]!=protected["approved.plan"]
   # Trusted verifier models a subsequent approval, only for disposable builtin state.
   run(["apply","-input=false","-auto-approve","-no-color",planfile])
   assert json.loads(run(["output","-json"]).stdout)["release"]["value"]=="release-b"

print("Native Terraform offline contract complete; no cloud provider or API")

title: 配置只读状态检查命令，按实际资源地址核对属性且不修改 state
answer:
### inspection.json
```json
{
  "list": [
    "state",
    "list"
  ],
  "detail": [
    "state",
    "show",
    "-no-color",
    "@address"
  ]
}

```

只编辑 inspection.json，两项都是原生 Terraform 参数数组：list 列出全部受管地址，detail 显示平台传入的单个资源地址及属性。动态地址用独立参数 @address 占位，平台每次替换为准确地址，不能硬编码 api。detail 关闭颜色，便于采集；只允许 state list/state show 读取命令，禁止 state rm/mv/push、apply 或其他写操作。验收器先在临时 builtin 状态创建不同 inventory，再执行你的参数，核对返回地址、随机资源 ID、service/quota，并比较读取前后 state。此命令看到的是 state，不代表远端健康。

## 原理与原题解答
state list 列出地址，state show 地址显示某个受管实例，show 可检查状态或计划的表示。输出可能含秘密，采集要脱敏。命令读取的是状态信息，判断实际存在和健康还需核对远端API。

```hcl
import json,os,subprocess,sys
expected=sys.argv[1]
```

answer:
### outputs.tf
```hcl
output "names" {
 value = {
  input = var.name
  local = local.name
  child = module.child.name
 }
}

```

只编辑 outputs.tf：唯一 names 对象的 input 读取当前输入，local 读取当前局部值，child 读取子模块公开输出。三者恰好同名，但作用域不同。不能在输出文件硬编码 local-/child- 字符串来模仿实现；验收会更新只读素材副本中两个实现前缀，正确输出仍须从对应接口取得。不要穿透访问子模块未公开内部数据。

## 原理与原题解答
分别引用当前模块输入变量、局部值和子模块导出的输出。局部值块使用 locals，但引用使用 local。不能直接穿透子模块访问未导出的内部资源，接口应通过 output 明确提供。

### plan_gate.py
```hcl
import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys

status={0:"unchanged",1:"error",2:"changes"}.get(p.returncode,"error")
print(json.dumps({"terraform_exit":p.returncode,"status":status},sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(1 if status=="error" else 0)

```

修复 plan_gate.py，参数为给定 tfvars JSON 路径。脚本必须实际执行 terraform plan -detailed-exitcode -input=false，并把原生命令退出码 0/1/2 分别报告为 unchanged/error/changes；标准输出只能是 {terraform_exit:实际整数,status:分类} JSON，脚本自身 error 退出 1，其余退出 0。不要 apply、改配置、改状态或把所有非零忽略。验收从已应用的内置 capacity=2 状态测试无变更、新值 5 和非法值 -1；原始计划日志可捕获但不要混进 JSON。本练习不修改 Jenkins 或云端。

## 原理与原题解答
0表示成功且没有差异，1表示错误，2表示成功且存在差异。CI需要保留真实退出码并区分变更与故障；把所有非零当失败会误报，把所有非零都忽略则会掩盖认证或语法问题。

## 环境与初始材料
网页离线 Terraform 配置练习，验收需要平台隔离工作区内的 Terraform 1.13.5 和 Python。缺工具时为待验收；不要求学员搭建云环境。给定材料使用内置 terraform_data 与隔离临时状态，实验包含预期失败的 apply，不连接云账号。

## 操作任务
修复 policy.tf.json 的阻断策略，同时保留独立的非阻断 advisory 检查。要求：① approved=false 在计划期拒绝，两个资源均不得创建；② approved=true 且 observed=expected 时两个内置资源成功，advisory_ok=false 只产生告警但不能阻断；③ observed 在 artifact.output 上于 apply 才确定，不等于 expected 时必须使 apply 失败、阻断依赖它的 release，但 artifact 本身已经进入本地状态，不能声称自动回滚。用 artifact 的 precondition/postcondition 和独立 check 表达这些时点，不得删除资源、断开依赖或让 release 直接读变量。只能使用给定两个内置资源，不运行远程 provider。本题的项目产物是可执行策略配置；验收覆盖四种状态、诊断、实际退出码及残留状态。

### summarize.py
```hcl

mapping={("create",):"+",("update",):"~",("delete",):"-",("delete","create"):"-/+",("create","delete"):"+/-"}
try:

  actions=tuple(item["change"]["actions"])
  if actions==("no-op",):continue
  if actions not in mapping:raise ValueError("unsupported managed resource action")
  rows.append({"address":item["address"],"symbol":mapping[actions],"actions":list(actions)})

except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) as exc:
 print(str(exc),file=sys.stderr)
 raise SystemExit(2)

```

title: 补上删除配置后的计划保护门禁，验证 prevent_destroy 边界
answer:
### guard.py
```hcl
import json,sys
data=json.load(open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf8"))
protected=set(json.load(open(sys.argv[2],encoding="utf8")))
blocked=sorted(item["address"] for item in data.get("resource_changes",[]) if item.get("mode","managed")=="managed" and item["address"] in protected and "delete" in item["change"]["actions"])
print(json.dumps({"allowed":not blocked,"blocked":blocked},sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(4 if blocked else 0)

```

FILES=['main.tf.json', 'protected.json', 'guard.py']
import pathlib,json,tempfile,subprocess,os,hashlib,contextlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("TF_")}
  env.update({"CHECKPOINT_DISABLE":"1","TF_IN_AUTOMATION":"1","TF_INPUT":"0","TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE":str(cli),"TF_DATA_DIR":str(box/"data")})
  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run.env=env
  run(["init","-backend=false","-get=false","-input=false","-no-color"])
  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run
def plan(inputs=None,overrides=None,flags=None,envvars=None,reject=False):
 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]
  if inputs is not None:
   (root/"case-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])

   return None

  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

  replace["resource"]["terraform_data"]["protected"]["lifecycle"]={"create_before_destroy":cbd}
  cases.append((replace,["terraform_data.protected"]))

  run(["plan","-input=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"])

FILES=['main.tf', 'root-token.tf.json', 'modules/credential/interface.tf.json', 'fixtures/probe-policy.json']
import pathlib,json,tempfile,subprocess,os,hashlib,contextlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("TF_")}
  env.update({"CHECKPOINT_DISABLE":"1","TF_IN_AUTOMATION":"1","TF_INPUT":"0","TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE":str(cli),"TF_DATA_DIR":str(box/"data")})
  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run.env=env
  run(["init","-backend=false","-get=true","-input=false","-no-color"])
  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run
def plan(inputs=None,overrides=None,flags=None,envvars=None,reject=False):
 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]
  if inputs is not None:
   (root/"case-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])
  p=run(args,good=False)
  if reject:
   assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid/missing input accepted"
   return None
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)

 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")

   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name

  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")

   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr

  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]

  args+=list(flags or [])

  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"

def outputs(data):

### lock-probe.py
```python
import json,os,re,subprocess,sys,pathlib
tf=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
p=subprocess.run([tf,"plan","-input=false","-no-color","-lock-timeout=0s","-detailed-exitcode"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8")
if p.returncode in (0,2):
 print(json.dumps({"status":"ready","changes":p.returncode==2,"retry":False,"cloud_verified":False}))
elif "Error acquiring the state lock" in p.stderr:
 def field(name):
  m=re.search(r"^\s*"+re.escape(name)+r":\s*(.+)$",p.stderr,re.M)
  return m.group(1).strip() if m else None
 lock_id=field("ID");operation=field("Operation");who=field("Who")
 if not lock_id or not operation or not who:
  try:
   info=json.loads(pathlib.Path(".terraform.tfstate.lock.info").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
   lock_id=info.get("ID");operation=info.get("Operation");who=info.get("Who")
  except (OSError,ValueError):pass
 if not lock_id or not operation or not who:
  print(json.dumps({"status":"error","retry":False,"cloud_verified":False}));raise SystemExit(2)
 print(json.dumps({"status":"busy","lock_id":lock_id,"operation":operation,"owner":who,"retry":True,"cloud_verified":False}))
else:
 print(json.dumps({"status":"error","retry":False,"cloud_verified":False}));raise SystemExit(2)

```

原生锁诊断已确认后可补读 lock.info，释放后以真实 plan 成功为准，不以文件是否存在作为锁判据。


核对锁ID、持有者和第一个作业进度，保持互斥并让第二个等待或退出。强行解除活动锁可能导致并发状态写入和重复操作。若首作业终止，先核对远端部分变更及锁状态后再决定恢复；验收应证明同一状态只有一个写者。

FILES=['variables.tf', 'main.tf', 'fixtures/environment.txt']
import pathlib,json,tempfile,subprocess,os,hashlib,contextlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("TF_")}
  env.update({"CHECKPOINT_DISABLE":"1","TF_IN_AUTOMATION":"1","TF_INPUT":"0","TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE":str(cli),"TF_DATA_DIR":str(box/"data")})
  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run.env=env
  run(["init","-backend=false","-get=false","-input=false","-no-color"])
  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run
def plan(inputs=None,overrides=None,flags=None,envvars=None,reject=False):
 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]
  if inputs is not None:
   (root/"case-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])
  p=run(args,good=False)
  if reject:
   assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid/missing input accepted"
   return None
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8").encode()).hexdigest()==digest,"readonly material changed"
expected={x for x in FILES if x.endswith((".tf",".tf.json"))}
actual={p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix() for p in BASE.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name.endswith((".tf",".tf.json")) and not p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix().startswith("checks/")}
assert actual==expected,"extra or missing Terraform configuration"

for service in [{"host":"api.training","port":8080},{"host":"edge.example","port":443},{"host":"内部.training","port":80}]:
 with work() as (root,run):
  (root/"input.json").write_text(json.dumps({"service":service}),encoding="utf8")
  run(["plan","-input=false","-no-color","-var-file=input.json","-out=case.plan"])
  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data["configuration"]["root_module"]
  assert not module.get("module_calls")
  assert len(module.get("resources",[]))==1 and not module["resources"][0].get("provisioners"),"extra resource or executable provisioner"
  rc=data["resource_changes"];assert len(rc)==1 and rc[0]["address"]=="terraform_data.service"
  assert rc[0]["change"]["actions"]==["create"] and equal(rc[0]["change"]["after"]["input"],service)
  assert set(data.get("output_changes",{}))=={"endpoint"}
  assert data["output_changes"]["endpoint"].get("after_unknown") is True,"endpoint must depend on actual resource output"
  run(["apply","-auto-approve","-input=false","-no-color","case.plan"])
  output=json.loads(run(["output","-json"]).stdout)
  assert output["endpoint"]["value"]=="http://"+service["host"]+":"+str(service["port"])
  state=json.loads(run(["show","-json"]).stdout)
  r=state["values"]["root_module"]["resources"];assert len(r)==1 and r[0]["address"]=="terraform_data.service"
  assert equal(r[0]["values"]["input"],service) and equal(r[0]["values"]["output"],service)
  assert isinstance(r[0]["values"]["id"],str) and r[0]["values"]["id"]
  snapshot=(root/"terraform.tfstate").read_bytes()
  unchanged=run(["plan","-input=false","-no-color","-var-file=input.json","-detailed-exitcode"],good=False)
  assert unchanged.returncode==0,unchanged.stdout+unchanged.stderr
  assert (root/"terraform.tfstate").read_bytes()==snapshot

print("Native Terraform offline contract complete; no cloud provider or API")

网页离线 Terraform 配置练习，验收需要平台隔离工作区内的 Terraform 1.13.5 和 Python。缺工具时为待验收；不要求学员搭建云环境。可信验收启动仅127.0.0.1随机端口的临时HTTP后端，使用假凭据与内置资源，执行结束自动关闭；隔离环境需允许loopback socket。

## 操作任务
修改 backend-options.json，将后端认证改为环境凭据；实现 scan-artifacts.py artifact-dir secrets.json，在导出前检查后端缓存元数据、saved.plan 和 run.log。saved.plan 是 ZIP，必须检查解压后的全部成员，不能只对压缩字节搜索。发现假用户名/密码、缺失制品、损坏计划或超出大小界限均拒绝导出，退出2；报告只含路径/错误与 allow_export，不回显秘密。环境方案生成干净制品时退出0。可信验收以仅绑定127.0.0.1的临时HTTP服务验证用户名/密码真实生效，原生 init/plan分别生成命令行凭据泄漏和环境凭据制品；另测清掉元数据但plan仍含秘密的残留路径，以及错误密码导致原生访问失败。受控缓存与计划仍需访问控制：无本次假凭据不等于不存在其他敏感数据。服务由验收自动启停，不要求学员搭环境；未验证真实云端凭据服务、轮换或云身份。

## 产物
- backend-options.json：提交完整配置。
- scan-artifacts.py：提交完整配置。

仅修改以上文件，保留其他只读输入；仅提交认证来源配置和制品扫描器；只读资源配置不变，禁止公网/业务后端、真实秘密和额外资源。

## 验收方法
可信 checks/check.py 在独立临时目录实际执行 terraform init/validate/plan/show，解析计划输出，多输入与错误输入核对。使用空 provider 镜像和禁交互参数，无云 API 验收；原生 HTTP 后端认证、缓存泄漏、压缩plan泄漏、环境凭据及缺失/损坏制品均实测；未连接云服务。

FILES=['main.tf', 'backend-options.json', 'scan-artifacts.py', 'fixtures/artifact-policy.json']
import pathlib,json,tempfile,subprocess,os,hashlib,contextlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("TF_")}
  env.update({"CHECKPOINT_DISABLE":"1","TF_IN_AUTOMATION":"1","TF_INPUT":"0","TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE":str(cli),"TF_DATA_DIR":str(box/"data")})
  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run.env=env
  run(["init","-backend=false","-get=false","-input=false","-no-color"])
  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run
def plan(inputs=None,overrides=None,flags=None,envvars=None,reject=False):
 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]
  if inputs is not None:
   (root/"case-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])
  p=run(args,good=False)
  if reject:
   assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid/missing input accepted"
   return None
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

FIXED={'main.tf': '22d5c50710a12c9e38447e21b21e6f807802744065316ad9bf564b7bf1702366', 'fixtures/artifact-policy.json': '72fed8d79d4c99e26d3cca78a9cdea84626c50cf7e2423aacfd21473979acd82'}
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8").encode()).hexdigest()==digest,"readonly material changed"
expected={x for x in FILES if x.endswith((".tf",".tf.json"))}
actual={p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix() for p in BASE.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name.endswith((".tf",".tf.json")) and not p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix().startswith("checks/")}
assert actual==expected,"extra or missing Terraform configuration"

import sys,threading,http.server,base64,shutil,copy
options=json.loads((BASE/"backend-options.json").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
assert set(options)=={"authentication"} and options["authentication"] in {"environment","backend-config"}
user="opsforge-training-user-52a";password="dummy-password-89c1";secretbytes=[user.encode(),password.encode()]
record={"body":None,"accepted":0,"denied":0}
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
 def auth(self):
  expected="Basic "+base64.b64encode((user+":"+password).encode()).decode()
  if self.headers.get("Authorization")!=expected:
   record["denied"]+=1;self.send_response(401);self.end_headers();return False
  record["accepted"]+=1;return True
 def do_GET(self):
  if not self.auth():return
  body=record["body"]
  self.send_response(404 if body is None else 200);self.end_headers()
  if body is not None:self.wfile.write(body)
 def do_POST(self):
  if not self.auth():return
  record["body"]=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length","0")))
  self.send_response(200);self.end_headers()
server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Handler);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
try:
 with work() as (root,run):
  address="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)+"/state"
  (root/"secrets.json").write_text(json.dumps({"values":[user,password]}),encoding="utf8")
  def generate(label,mode):
   data=root/("cache-"+label);run.env["TF_DATA_DIR"]=str(data)
   run.env.pop("TF_HTTP_USERNAME",None);run.env.pop("TF_HTTP_PASSWORD",None)
   run.env["TF_HTTP_RETRY_MAX"]="0"
   args=["init","-input=false","-no-color","-reconfigure","-backend-config=address="+address]
   if mode=="environment":run.env.update(TF_HTTP_USERNAME=user,TF_HTTP_PASSWORD=password)
   else:args+=["-backend-config=username="+user,"-backend-config=password="+password]
   run(args);run(["plan","-input=false","-no-color","-out="+label+".plan"])
   artifacts=root/("artifacts-"+label);(artifacts/".terraform").mkdir(parents=True)
   (artifacts/".terraform/terraform.tfstate").write_bytes((data/"terraform.tfstate").read_bytes())
   (artifacts/"saved.plan").write_bytes((root/(label+".plan")).read_bytes())
   (artifacts/"run.log").write_text("init and plan completed; credential values redacted\n",encoding="utf8")
   return artifacts
  def scan(artifacts):
   return subprocess.run([sys.executable,"scan-artifacts.py",str(artifacts),"secrets.json"],cwd=root,env=run.env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=10)
  bad=generate("cli","backend-config")
  native_meta=(bad/".terraform/terraform.tfstate").read_bytes()
  assert all(s in native_meta for s in secretbytes),"native leaked credential fixture not reproduced"
  result=scan(bad);assert result.returncode==2,result.stdout+result.stderr
  report=json.loads(result.stdout);assert report["allow_export"] is False and report["findings"] and not report["errors"]
  assert any(x.startswith("saved.plan!") for x in report["findings"]),"must inspect actual compressed native plan"
  assert all(s.decode() not in result.stdout+result.stderr for s in secretbytes)
  # Removing leaked cache alone does not repair the already generated plan.
  (bad/".terraform/terraform.tfstate").write_text("{}\n",encoding="utf8")
  result=scan(bad);assert result.returncode==2
  assert any(x.startswith("saved.plan!") for x in json.loads(result.stdout)["findings"])
  good=generate("candidate",options["authentication"])
  result=scan(good);assert result.returncode==0,result.stdout+result.stderr
  expected={"allow_export":True,"findings":[],"errors":[],"scanned":[".terraform/terraform.tfstate","saved.plan","run.log"],"scope":"local_http_backend_artifacts"}
  assert equal(json.loads(result.stdout),expected)
  for name in ["saved.plan","run.log"]:
   p=good/name;before=p.read_bytes()
   if name=="saved.plan":p.write_bytes(b"corrupted plan")
   else:p.unlink()
   result=scan(good);assert result.returncode==2 and name in json.loads(result.stdout)["errors"]
   p.write_bytes(before)
  # Size limits are independently exercised, including compressed expansion.
  logfile=good/"run.log";original_log=logfile.read_bytes();logfile.write_bytes(b"x"*10_000_001)
  result=scan(good);assert result.returncode==2 and "run.log" in json.loads(result.stdout)["errors"]
  logfile.write_bytes(original_log)
  import zipfile
  planfile=good/"saved.plan";original_plan=planfile.read_bytes()
  with zipfile.ZipFile(planfile,"w",zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:z.writestr("expanded",b"x"*20_000_001)
  result=scan(good);assert result.returncode==2 and "saved.plan" in json.loads(result.stdout)["errors"]
  planfile.write_bytes(original_plan)
  # Authentication is exercised against the temporary service, not inferred from config fields.
  run.env["TF_HTTP_PASSWORD"]="wrong-password"
  denied_before=record["denied"];native=run(["plan","-input=false","-no-color"],good=False)
  assert native.returncode!=0 and record["denied"]>denied_before
  run.env["TF_HTTP_PASSWORD"]=password
  run(["apply","-auto-approve","-input=false","-no-color","candidate.plan"])
  assert record["accepted"]>0 and record["body"] is not None
  saved=json.loads(record["body"]);assert saved.get("resources")
finally:
 server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=2)

print("Native Terraform offline contract complete; no cloud provider or API")

answer:
### ci-check.py
```hcl
import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
tf=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
stages=[("fmt",["fmt","-check","-recursive","-no-color"]),("init",["init","-backend=false","-input=false","-no-color"]),("validate",["validate","-json"]),("plan",["plan","-input=false","-no-color","-out=checked.plan"])]
if len(sys.argv)>1:stages[-1][1].append("-var-file="+sys.argv[1])
completed=[]
for stage,args in stages:
 p=subprocess.run([tf,*args],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8")
 if p.returncode:
  print(json.dumps({"stage":stage,"completed":completed,"plan_ready":False,"applied":False}));raise SystemExit(2)
 completed.append(stage)
print(json.dumps({"stage":"ready","completed":completed,"plan_ready":True,"applied":False}))

```

实现 ci-check.py [input.json]，按 fmt只检查→init→validate→plan 顺序运行原生工具，任一阶段失败立即退出2并输出失败阶段及已完成阶段，不得改写配置或自动apply。成功保存 checked.plan 并报告 plan_ready:true、applied:false。验收区分格式错误、语义未定义引用、缺少必填变量和有效计划四种情况；规范格式只能由开发另行修正，流水线检查不能偷偷修改源码。检查通过只证明当前输入可规划，不能保证云端apply成功；本题内置资源未被apply。

## 原理与原题解答
fmt主要检查格式，validate检查配置内部一致性，plan还结合输入、状态和provider信息，实际测试可验证创建与销毁。它们不能互相替代；会创建资源的测试须隔离账户、设预算并验证清理，不能在生产偷偷执行。

FILES=['main.tf', 'ci-check.py', 'fixtures/ci-policy.json']
import pathlib,json,tempfile,subprocess,os,hashlib,contextlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=box/"empty-provider-mirror";mirror.mkdir()
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("TF_")}
  env.update({"CHECKPOINT_DISABLE":"1","TF_IN_AUTOMATION":"1","TF_INPUT":"0","TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE":str(cli),"TF_DATA_DIR":str(box/"data")})
  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run.env=env
  run(["init","-backend=false","-get=false","-input=false","-no-color"])
  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run
def plan(inputs=None,overrides=None,flags=None,envvars=None,reject=False):
 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]
  if inputs is not None:
   (root/"case-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])
  p=run(args,good=False)
  if reject:
   assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid/missing input accepted"
   return None
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

for name,digest in FIXED.items():

assert actual==expected,"extra or missing Terraform configuration"

import sys
with work() as (root,run):
 source=(BASE/"main.tf").read_text(encoding="utf8")
 cases=[
  ("format",source.replace("  input = var.message","input=var.message"),{"message":"format-case"},"fmt",[]),
  ("semantic",source.replace("var.message","var.not_declared"),{"message":"semantic-case"},"validate",["fmt","init"]),
  ("missing",source,None,"plan",["fmt","init","validate"]),
  ("valid",source,{"message":"request-specific-value"},"ready",["fmt","init","validate","plan"])
 ]

  p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,env=run.env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
  assert p.returncode==(0 if stage=="ready" else 2),name+p.stdout+p.stderr
  assert equal(json.loads(p.stdout),{"stage":stage,"completed":completed,"plan_ready":stage=="ready","applied":False}),name+p.stdout

TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")

  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"

title: 为根资源显式绑定两个 provider alias 并核对实际状态归属
answer:
### main.tf
```hcl
resource "terraform_data" "primary" {
 provider = terraform.primary
 input = var.primary_marker
}
resource "terraform_data" "secondary" {
 provider = terraform.secondary
 count = var.secondary_enabled ? 1 : 0
 input = var.secondary_marker
}

```

修复main.tf：primary资源绑定terraform.primary，secondary绑定terraform.secondary，并保留动态input及secondary_enabled的数量条件。实际apply后核对state保存的provider地址；两组输入更新应保留各自ID，关闭secondary仅移除其本题对象。内置terraform provider没有region参数，这里只验证alias选择机制；east/west只是输入标签，不能用它们证明AWS区域正确。真实云区域身份仍需云provider/API能力，本题不提供该验收。

## 原理与原题解答
使用同一provider的多个alias配置不同区域，在资源provider参数或模块providers映射中选择。每个子模块声明自己需要的provider与别名能力；核对数据源也使用正确配置，不能仅以资源名称推断区域。

## 操作任务
完成network、database、application三个独立根配置。各自只管理同名terraform_data：network输出contract_version=1和实际network_id；database仅通过network的公开输出构造network_id/engine并输出版本1与实际database_id；application仅消费database公开输出构造database_id/release。两层消费者都拒绝非1版本契约。各自使用独立state，不复制ID常量，不跨层读取完整state JSON。验收真实初始化/按依赖apply，核对三条lineage、对象归属及输入；应用更新/销毁/重新创建必须保持上游state字节不变。再用测试专属override模拟上游升级，要求下游plan拒绝且下游state不写。这里的网络/数据库是内置资源的状态边界模型，不创建真实VPC或数据库，也未验证云IAM读取隔离。

## 产物
- network/main.tf.json：提交完整配置。
- database/main.tf.json：提交完整配置。

```python
import os,pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,urllib.request,urllib.error
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();approval=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf8"))

raw=(root/"terraform.tfstate").read_bytes();state=json.loads(raw)
assert approval["state_sha256"]==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert approval["lineage"]==state["lineage"] and approval["approved"] is True
address=approval["target"]
assert address.startswith("http://127.0.0.1:") and address.endswith("/state")
try:
 urllib.request.urlopen(address,timeout=3).read()
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
 assert error.code==404,"target backend unavailable"
else:raise ValueError("target backend is not empty")
backup=root/"pre-migration.tfstate"
assert not backup.exists()
backup.write_bytes(raw)
backend=root/"backend.tf";old=backend.read_bytes()
(root/"pre-migration-backend.txt").write_bytes(old)
backend.write_text('terraform {\n backend "http" {}\n}\n',encoding="utf8")
p=subprocess.run([tf,"init","-migrate-state","-force-copy","-input=false","-no-color","-backend-config=address="+address],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
p=subprocess.run([tf,"state","pull"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
migrated=json.loads(p.stdout)
def inventory(s):
 return sorted((r["type"],r["name"],str(i.get("index_key","")),i["attributes"]["id"]) for r in s.get("resources",[]) for i in r["instances"])
assert migrated.get("lineage") and inventory(migrated)==inventory(state)
print(json.dumps({"migrated":True,"source_lineage":state["lineage"],"target_lineage":migrated["lineage"],"objects":len(inventory(migrated)),"backup_sha256":hashlib.sha256(backup.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))

```

迁入空HTTP后端会建立目标lineage；记录来源和目标，核对全部对象及原始备份，而非假定lineage/serial保持。此流程只用于单写者隔离验收；空目标检查存在TOCTOU窗口，生产迁移需独占控制与后端锁。

## 原理与原题解答
暂停并发写入并备份状态，先独立准备受保护后端，再通过 init -migrate-state 迁移。核对 lineage、serial、资源地址和关键ID，重新 plan 确认没有意外重建；其他执行器也切换完成后才处理旧副本，失败时保留恢复证据。

### orchestrate.py
```hcl
import json,pathlib,os,subprocess,sys
base=pathlib.Path.cwd();request=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf8"))
jobs=request["jobs"];allowed={"network","database","application"}
assert len(jobs)==3 and {j["name"] for j in jobs}==allowed
byname={j["name"]:j for j in jobs}
assert all(j["approved"] is True and set(j["depends_on"])<=allowed and j["name"] not in j["depends_on"] for j in jobs)
order=[];pending=set(allowed)
while pending:
 ready=sorted(n for n in pending if set(byname[n]["depends_on"])<=set(order))
 assert ready,"dependency cycle"
 order.extend(ready);pending-=set(ready)
# The supplied native modules require exactly these upstream relationships.
assert set(byname["network"]["depends_on"])==set()
assert set(byname["database"]["depends_on"])=={"network"}
assert set(byname["application"]["depends_on"])=={"database"}
status={};tf=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
for name in order:
 root=base/name;env=dict(os.environ);env["TF_DATA_DIR"]=str(root/".terraform")
 def run(args):return subprocess.run([tf,*args],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
 (root/"request-inputs.json").write_text(json.dumps(byname[name]["inputs"]),encoding="utf8")
 init=run(["init","-backend=false","-input=false","-no-color"])
 if init.returncode:
  print(json.dumps({"status":status,"failed":name,"phase":"init"}));raise SystemExit(1)
 plan=run(["plan","-input=false","-no-color","-detailed-exitcode","-var-file=request-inputs.json","-out=approved.plan"])
 if plan.returncode not in (0,2):
  print(json.dumps({"status":status,"failed":name,"phase":"plan"}));raise SystemExit(1)
 if plan.returncode==0:status[name]="no-op";continue
 apply=run(["apply","-auto-approve","-input=false","-no-color","approved.plan"])
 if apply.returncode:
  print(json.dumps({"status":status,"failed":name,"phase":"apply"}));raise SystemExit(1)
 status[name]="applied"
print(json.dumps({"status":status,"failed":None,"phase":"complete"}))

```

修复orchestrate.py，读取request.json的三个已批准jobs，在执行任何命令前验证唯一名称、所有批准、依赖存在且无环，并符合network→database→application。按拓扑顺序真实init/plan；plan返回2才apply该保存计划，0记录no-op，失败立即停止并报告已完成状态，绝不自动destroy上游。验收故意让database计划失败：network应保留、application不启动；修复输入后重新规划从实际状态恢复，最后重复执行三层均no-op且state字节不变。请求中的approved仅用于此本地练习的审批输入，不是防篡改生产审批；工作区假设单编排器，未实现跨进程互斥，不可宣称生产并发安全。

## 原理与原题解答
建立根配置依赖DAG，每套绑定状态、身份、输入和计划制品；仅对已批准节点应用并记录完成状态。下游失败不意味着上游可无条件销毁，恢复应从实际状态重新规划。验证并发互斥、断点恢复和重复执行幂等性。

title: 捕获原生terraform test清理失败，区分断言成功与资源清理完成
body:
## 环境与初始材料
网页离线 Terraform 配置练习，验收需要平台隔离工作区内的 Terraform 1.13.5 和 Python。缺工具时为待验收；不要求学员搭建云环境。需要平台预置官方local2.5.3离线mirror，隔离临时文件与Python故障探针；无云连接。依赖未就绪时待验收。

## 操作任务
修复capture-test.py，执行真实terraform test -json -verbose并保留原始事件。两条run可以都pass，但teardown因local_file路径被只读故障探针替换成非空目录而失败；必须按原生test_cleanup.failed_resources和summary.status报告cleanup_required，退出2，并保留现场，不能以failed计数为0当整套成功或自动删目录掩盖残留。正常运行退出0、纯断言失败但清理成功退出1。导出test-evidence.json保存实际summary、failed_resources及verbose test_state诊断快照；明确这些展示快照不是可直接state push的完整state。平台会自动创建/隔离故障材料；本题只生成清理处置证据，不自动批准删除残留，也不声称云资源清理。

## 产物
- capture-test.py：提交完整配置。

仅修改以上文件，保留其他只读输入；只提交事件捕获脚本，禁止修改测试/探针、自动删除残留证据、连接云或推送展示快照为state。

## 验收方法
可信 checks/check.py 在独立临时目录实际执行 terraform init/validate/plan/show，解析计划输出，多输入与错误输入核对。仅使用固定 local 2.5.3 文件系统镜像、禁止 direct 下载回退，并使用禁交互参数，无云 API 验收；真实test的三种结果及teardown残留验证，仅本地provider；不等价云资源清理或灾备。
answer:
### capture-test.py
```hcl
import json,pathlib,subprocess,os,sys
tf=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
p=subprocess.run([tf,"test","-json","-verbose","-var=python_executable="+sys.executable],capture_output=True,text=True)
pathlib.Path("native-test.jsonl").write_text(p.stdout,encoding="utf8")
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
summary=next(r["test_summary"] for r in reversed(rows) if r.get("type")=="test_summary")
failed=sorted({x["instance"] for r in rows if r.get("type")=="test_cleanup" for x in r["test_cleanup"].get("failed_resources",[])})
snapshots=[{"run":r.get("@testrun"),"state":r["test_state"]} for r in rows if r.get("type")=="test_state"]
classification="cleanup_required" if failed else ("passed" if p.returncode==0 and summary["status"]=="pass" else "test_failed")
report={"classification":classification,"process_exit":p.returncode,"summary":summary,"failed_resources":failed,"snapshots":snapshots,"snapshots_are_pushable_state":False}
pathlib.Path("test-evidence.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
print(json.dumps({"classification":classification,"failed_resources":failed}))
raise SystemExit(2 if failed else (0 if classification=="passed" else 1))

```

修复capture-test.py，执行真实terraform test -json -verbose并保留原始事件。两条run可以都pass，但teardown因local_file路径被只读故障探针替换成非空目录而失败；必须按原生test_cleanup.failed_resources和summary.status报告cleanup_required，退出2，并保留现场，不能以failed计数为0当整套成功或自动删目录掩盖残留。正常运行退出0、纯断言失败但清理成功退出1。导出test-evidence.json保存实际summary、failed_resources及verbose test_state诊断快照；明确这些展示快照不是可直接state push的完整state。平台会自动创建/隔离故障材料；本题只生成清理处置证据，不自动批准删除残留，也不声称云资源清理。

## 原理与原题解答
交付每个test运行创建的资源边界、测试状态生命周期、账户配额、费用预算及清理失败的对象定位方法。terraform test可运行真实apply，不能因为文件位于测试目录就当作只读；运行块间的状态关系、不同模块配置和测试结束的销毁行为需按固定版本核对。验收用独立账户或明确隔离前缀验证成功结束清理，再注入清理权限被收回、依赖资源仍被占用和进程中断，确认报告保留资源ID与恢复线索。失败立即阻止继续重复测试累积资源，先基于测试状态与远端审计清点残留，再按批准方案清理。生产状态不得作为测试状态直接复用，且不能通过删测试工作目录宣称资源已销毁；报告应把断言失败和清理失败分别呈现。

原题：terraform test使用真实Provider时，如何交付测试状态隔离与清理失败处置？

FILES=['main.tf', 'sabotage.py', 'tests/cleanup.tftest.hcl', 'capture-test.py']
import pathlib,json,tempfile,subprocess,os,hashlib,contextlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
TF=os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TERRAFORM","terraform")
def equal(a,b):
 if isinstance(a,bool) or isinstance(b,bool):return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
 if isinstance(a,(int,float)) and isinstance(b,(int,float)):return a==b
 if type(a) is not type(b):return False
 if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return a==b
@contextlib.contextmanager
def work(overrides=None,envvars=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-tf-") as tmp:
  box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/"root";root.mkdir();mirror=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TF_PROVIDER_MIRROR",""));assert os.environ.get("OPSFORGE_TF_PROVIDER_MIRROR") and mirror.is_dir(),"fixed offline provider mirror is required"
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,value in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   dest=root/name
   if value is None:dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
   else:dest.write_text(value,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  cli=box/"terraform.rc"
  cli.write_text("disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation {\n filesystem_mirror {\n  path = "+json.dumps(mirror.as_posix())+"\n }\n}\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("TF_")}
  env.update({"CHECKPOINT_DISABLE":"1","TF_IN_AUTOMATION":"1","TF_INPUT":"0","TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE":str(cli),"TF_DATA_DIR":str(box/"data")})
  env.update(envvars or {})
  def run(args,good=True,stdin=None):
   p=subprocess.run([TF,*args],cwd=root,env=env,input=stdin,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=20)
   if good:assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   return p
  run.env=env
  run(["init","-backend=false","-get=false","-input=false","-no-color"])
  val=json.loads(run(["validate","-json"]).stdout);assert val["valid"],val
  yield root,run
def plan(inputs=None,overrides=None,flags=None,envvars=None,reject=False):
 with work(overrides,envvars) as (root,run):
  args=["plan","-input=false","-lock=false","-no-color","-out=case.plan"]
  if inputs is not None:
   (root/"case-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf8")
   args+=["-var-file=case-input.json"]
  args+=list(flags or [])
  p=run(args,good=False)
  if reject:
   assert p.returncode!=0,"invalid/missing input accepted"
   return None
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  data=json.loads(run(["show","-json","case.plan"]).stdout)
  module=data.get("configuration",{}).get("root_module",{})
  assert not module.get("resources") and not module.get("module_calls"),"this task permits pure expressions only"
  assert not data.get("resource_changes"),"unexpected resource change"
  return data
def outputs(data):
 return {k:v.get("value") for k,v in data.get("planned_values",{}).get("outputs",{}).items()}

FIXED={'main.tf': 'd2338bf49064a724d91f59a86010b12692f9c67b57f0239d60121c2dd5ab504d', 'sabotage.py': 'a7dddf84cc90980a43ac94fa7de99567ed17d2cfa85ceefd2df1bd0654187e43', 'tests/cleanup.tftest.hcl': '6f89dca7df2be0be520992c2685aadddedb3baebbdfb457b8e1fab7b5c4055ee'}
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8").encode()).hexdigest()==digest,"readonly material changed"
expected={x for x in FILES if x.endswith((".tf",".tf.json"))}
actual={p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix() for p in BASE.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name.endswith((".tf",".tf.json")) and not p.relative_to(BASE).as_posix().startswith("checks/")}
assert actual==expected,"extra or missing Terraform configuration"

import sys
for scenario in ["cleanup-error","clean","assertion-error"]:
 override={}
 if scenario=="clean":override["tests/cleanup.tftest.hcl"]=(BASE/"tests/cleanup.tftest.hcl").read_text().replace("inject = true","inject = false")
 if scenario=="assertion-error":override["tests/cleanup.tftest.hcl"]='run "assertion_failure" {\n command = apply\n assert {\n condition = local_file.marker.content == "wrong"\n error_message = "Deliberate assertion failure"\n }\n}\n'
 with work(override) as (root,run):
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"capture-test.py"],cwd=root,env=run.env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=30)
  report=json.loads((root/"test-evidence.json").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
  rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/"native-test.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
  summary=next(r["test_summary"] for r in reversed(rows) if r.get("type")=="test_summary")
  failed=sorted({x["instance"] for r in rows if r.get("type")=="test_cleanup" for x in r["test_cleanup"].get("failed_resources",[])})
  snapshots=[{"run":r.get("@testrun"),"state":r["test_state"]} for r in rows if r.get("type")=="test_state"]
  assert report["summary"]==summary and report["failed_resources"]==failed and report["snapshots"]==snapshots
  assert report["snapshots_are_pushable_state"] is False
  assert not (root/"terraform.tfstate").exists(),"test state must not be presented as deployment state"
  if scenario=="cleanup-error":
   assert p.returncode==2 and report["classification"]=="cleanup_required" and report["process_exit"]!=0
   assert summary["passed"]==2 and summary["failed"]==0 and summary["status"]=="error"
   assert failed==["local_file.marker","terraform_data.sabotage[0]"] and snapshots
   assert (root/"marker/owned.txt").read_text(encoding="utf8")=="owned","do not erase failed-cleanup evidence automatically"
  elif scenario=="clean":
   assert p.returncode==0 and report["classification"]=="passed" and not failed
   assert summary["status"]=="pass" and report["process_exit"]==0
   assert not (root/"marker").exists()
  else:
   assert p.returncode==1 and report["classification"]=="test_failed" and not failed
   assert summary["failed"]==1 and report["process_exit"]!=0
   assert not (root/"marker").exists(),"assertion failure still permits successful native teardown"
